inputs.text: The “No Kings” rally against Trump shows what happens when political theatrics are allowed to crowd out respect for the law. Streets are not a stage for agitators to confront authorities, and slogans do not excuse disorder. Federal officers used tear gas and made arrests; at least 13 were confirmed in Portland and Denver. A decent society depends on clear rules and the courage to enforce them—not on treating chaos as ordinary political expression.

subtopics: Respect for the law and enforcement
output.narrative_frame: Critical framing of the rally and protest-related disorder, emphasizing law enforcement and respect for the law.
